dedupe_keys.name: un comtrade database international merchandise and services trade statistics

description: UN Comtrade aggregates detailed annual and monthly international trade statistics by product and trading partner. The home page read on 2026-09-26 says the United Nations Statistics Division compiles data for about 200 countries covering more than 99 percent of world merchandise trade, offers a quick and advanced search, API developer tools and bulk download, and that access to detailed data is free while bulk download and extra functions need a premium subscription, with licensing through the subscriptions office. The help centre lists metadata on HS, SITC and BEC classifications, conversion tables, quantity units, historical data for 1900 to 1960, seaborne trade estimates and trade in services. Coverage is global, with data to 2025 on the page read. Caveats: exports and partner imports often disagree (bilateral asymmetries), annual totals may differ from summed months, and redistribution follows the UN Comtrade use policy. For simulation it gives bilateral commodity flows to build supply chain and trade disruption networks for industrial goods, minerals and food. Related catalogue records include the Eora2 global supply chain database, EXIOBASE and the WIOD.
